name: telegram-preview-bot
description: Sistema automatizado de prévias para Telegram com análise de imagens via Grok AI

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: if [ "$SERVICE_TYPE" = "dashboard" ]; then cd dashboard && npm run build; else cd backend && npx prisma generate && npm run build; fi
scripts.start: if [ "$SERVICE_TYPE" = "dashboard" ]; then cd dashboard && npm start; elif [ "$SERVICE_TYPE" = "worker" ]; then cd backend && node dist/workers/index.js; else cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/index.js; fi
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
